_comment: plg_system_tracyaccess is owned by Tracy's fleet provisioning (TracyHQ/tch, `path` below), which installs it on every site it hosts. This package carries a copy, and the self-updater installs that copy over whatever the site has: Joomla's installer does not refuse a lower version. So the copy must be the fleet's own bytes, never older. tests/tracyaccess-signed.php fails when a shipped file differs from these hashes. To take a new version: copy the directory from TCH, then update `commit`, `version` and every hash here.
